name: Luna 9 survivable lunar landing
description: Luna 9 survived a lunar landing and transmitted images from the surface.

impact.note: One probe showing a craft could land and operate on the Moon; used by one programme, with a few later landers following.

date.basis: Date stated in the cited source.

events.statement: The Soviet Luna 9 spacecraft landed on the Moon and remained operational.

evidence.supports: NASA history dates Luna 9 lunar touchdown to 3 February 1966 UTC and the first lunar-surface images to 4 February UTC. It lists Lavochkin as mission design and management.

events.caveats: UTC; the later crewed Apollo program is a different capability.
